backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no implemented logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing feature IDs, descriptions, associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains brief high-level summaries of major frontend files and components for build planning.
frontend/index.css: Empty stylesheet placeholder with no rules defined.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry with SEO metadata, preload hints, social tags, and JSON-LD LocalBusiness schema.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component assembling all landing page sections and providers in order.
frontend/src/components/chat/SupportChat: Empty file placeholder for the support chat widget component.
frontend/src/components/common/IconBadge: Reusable icon badge component with size and style variants using Tailwind classes.
frontend/src/components/common/InlineIco: Simple wrapper to render Lucide icons inline with consistent styling.
frontend/src/components/common/LogoWithB: Logo component rendering the company logo with configurable sizes and padded backing.
frontend/src/components/floating/Floatin: Floating WhatsApp and call buttons with premium styling and fixed bottom-left positioning.
frontend/src/components/landing/Appointm: Form component for booking appointments with validation, i18n text, and WhatsApp submission.
frontend/src/components/landing/AreasSer: Displays Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar areas in a styled grid with section headers and descriptive text.
frontend/src/components/landing/Footer.t: Renders the site footer with company info, social links, navigation links, and service lists.
frontend/src/components/landing/GoogleRe: Shows Google rating, sample customer reviews, and visual star elements in a styled review section.
frontend/src/components/landing/Header.t: Implements the sticky header with logo, navigation, language selector, and call/WhatsApp actions.
frontend/src/components/landing/Hero.tsx: Provides the main hero banner with background image, translated text, feature chips, reasons list, and call-to-action buttons.
frontend/src/components/landing/LivePhot: Displays a gallery of live cleaning photos with optional labels and responsive card layout.
frontend/src/components/landing/ServiceC: Displays a localized service coverage banner with a header, image, and caption.
frontend/src/components/landing/Services: Renders a list of cleaning services with themed cards, pricing, and translations.
frontend/src/components/landing/SofaPric: Provides an interactive sofa size slider to estimate cleaning cost with call and WhatsApp CTAs.
frontend/src/components/landing/WhyChoos: Shows a grid of feature cards explaining reasons to choose the service, using localized text.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an authentication context using Internet Identity with login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/i18n/I18nProvider.tsx: Provides locale state, persistence, and translation context to the app.
frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts: Defines translation types and keys for all localized UI text across the app.
frontend/src/i18n/useI18n.ts: Provides a hook to access the I18n context, throwing an error if used outside its provider.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, theme CSS variables, and custom utility classes for premium styling and dark mode.
frontend/src/lib/whatsappBooking.ts: Formats booking details into a WhatsApp message and generates a pre-filled WhatsApp URL.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, radius, shadows, content paths, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, requirements, conflicts, and existing feature definitions for the marketing site.
